about_the_game:
💖 Flirt with Even Monster Girls (Zombie, Angel, Vampire)

In this story-driven visual novel, you’ll meet stunning girls . E.g. a punk vampire who might crave your blood, a zombie girl hungry for something more, and a sweet, soaring angel who dreams of freedom.

Gameplay

As a rich, text-based interactive fiction, the story unfolds over five chapters. Each day brings you closer to the girls—learning their personalities, uncovering their kinks, and diving into their deepest, most passionate desires. But there’s a catch—at the end of each chapter, one girl must be let go, narrowing your choices until only one remains.

With every decision, the stakes rise, intensifying the connection between you and the remaining girls. By the final chapter, the passion reaches its peak, leading to an intimate, unforgettable night with the one who truly captured your heart.

25 Sexy 3D Scenes

At the end of each flirt with each girl, a new, sexy 3D scene will be unlocked, with a freely adjustable camera to view the girl from any and all angles. These 3D scenes reveal more of each girl's personality, from seductive poses to playful gestures.

Replayability

Even after finishing the game, it is possible to replay it from the start, unlocking further dialogue options with other girls. Each playthrough allows you to end up with another girl, eventually unlocking all animated 3D scenes and sex scenes.

The Girls

🧛 Komori – The Punk Vampire Girl A rebellious lead singer who lives for the thrill... and maybe your blood. Her band’s gothic style and her eerie charm are impossible to ignore. But is she really a vampire?

🧟 Kemuriko – The Cheerful Zombie Girl Bubbly, curious, and full of life—despite being undead. Having lost her memories of her past life, she now seeks joy and new experiences, even if that means some playful chaos.

👼 Sora – The Soaring Angel Girl A sweet and submissive girl who dreams of finding a strong partner she can rely on.

💪 Ryoko – The Gym Muscle Girl The strongest of the girls, Ryoko is a true tomboy, dedicated to pushing her physical limits in the gym.

🌸 Jochu – The Diligent Maid Girl A hardworking, cheerful maid who takes pride in doing her best for others, always eager to please.

Make your choices, build your connections, and decide who truly captures your heart. With 25 sexy 3D scenes and multiple endings, every playthrough can reveal something new.

Will you uncover their secrets...?
